# WO-168: 'Never asks for' copies agree with the /safety/ master list
Status: open (local start: tools/copilot.sh start WO-168)
Vendor: copilot
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (CLAUDE_TO_COPILOT.md)
Assigned to: Malik Johnson (Copilot test-quality), local Copilot CLI
Source: GP-22, accepted 2026-11-08 (CLAUDE-P013)

## Goal
A guard that each hand-written copy of the 'never asks for' promise (docs/USER_GUIDE.md, docs/HELPER_GUIDE.md, docs/FRIDGE_CARD.md, docs/FAMILY_QUICK_START.md, web/src/pages/families/) mentions the core items and never a bare 'passwords'. Master list: web/src/pages/safety/index.astro.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Core items (Morgan's decision): Social Security number; bank or card details; never charges you. Each copy must mention all three.
- A bare 'passwords' (without 'app password' or 'your email password' context) in a never-asks sentence fails.
- Copies failing today are strict xfail cases with file:line in the reason; do not edit the copies.
- If one of the named files does not exist, report it and skip it (no failure).
- `PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/copilot/` still passes (your shell may be refused; then say so).
- No real personal data; examples use Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL.
- Create no files outside the allowed paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/copilot/test_cp_never_asks_parity.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
Every other file. src/ is read-only.

## Check-in plan
VENDOR_STATUS.md when done; Grace summarises in COPILOT_TO_CLAUDE.md. Tracker issue: FreeMyID/freemyid-pm (Morgan mirrors).
